scripts.db:up: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose.dev.yaml -p sallimbook-dev up -d --wait db
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --env-file .env --project services/api alembic -c services/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.db:stop: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose.dev.yaml -p sallimbook-dev stop db
scripts.api:generate: uv run --project services/api python scripts/export_openapi.py && pnpm --filter @sallimbook/api-client generate
scripts.android:sync: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @sallimbook/client exec cap sync android
scripts.test:docs: python3 scripts/validate_docs.py && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
